description: Free, no sign-in. Use when someone asks when an English council’s rental licensing evidence was checked, which official sources changed, or where coverage is incomplete. Read-only. With a council slug, returns source links, comparison dates and independent field decisions. Omit the slug for national coverage and a paged council list. A publisher change is a research lead.

council.description: Exact council slug, for example hammersmith-and-fulham. Omit for national coverage.

edition.description: Pin this to the edition on the first page when following nextOffset.

limit.description: Up to 10 councils nationally or 10 distinct citations for a named council.

name: council_reviews
title: Council evidence and independent reviews
